title: Festive e-commerce 2026: quick commerce up 75%
takeaways: 21% year-on-year growth in festive order volumes.
75% order growth for quick commerce; marketplaces grew 8%.
41% of orders came from Tier-3 cities.
Conversion fell from 4% to 2% with 4–7 day delivery.
source_note: Sources: Unicommerce via Social Samosa, 6 Nov 2026; HiveMinds via MediaNews4U, 6 Nov 2026
